reason: Consent needs one short explanation and two equally available choices without interrupting the page as a modal or full-width strip.
regions: plain-language analytics explanation and Privacy Policy link

responsive.desktop: Bottom-left 470px overlay card with two equal-width actions.
responsive.mobile: Inset card with the same reading order and full-width stacked actions using 48px touch targets.

constraints: preserve the existing consent storage and event behavior
no advertising or cross-site tracking language
respect safe-area insets and reduced-motion preferences

rejected.full-width bottom bar: The current treatment makes the explanation and controls feel compressed and visually generic.
rejected.centered modal: Too disruptive for an optional analytics decision.
rejected.single emphasized choice: Would create a dark pattern instead of a balanced privacy decision.
